content.text: I've surveyed fees, term/termination, effect of termination, remedies, and general provisions. No Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, minimum-shortfall true-up, or early-termination fee exists.

input.quote: ARTICLE XXIII NON EXCLUSIVE REMEDY Termination of this Agreement by either party will be a nonexclusive remedy for breach and will be without prejudice to any other right or remedy of such party. NO DAMAGES FOR TERMINATION. NEITHER PARTY WILL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER FOR DAMAGES OF ANY KIND, INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES, DAMAGES FOR THE LOSS OF GOODWILL, PROSPECTIVE PROFITS OR ANTICIPATED INCOME, OR DAMAGES RESULTING FROM ANY EXPENDITURES, INVESTMENTS, LEASES OR COMMITMENTS MADE BY EITHER PARTY ON ACCOUNT OF THE TERMINATION OR EXPIRATION OF THIS AGREEMENT IN ACCORDANCE WITH ITS TERMS.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, stipulated-damages or early-termination charge payable by us as Licensee, so the rule's preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties) is met. Compensation to Licensor is purely usage-based: the volume-tiered user fees (p0056-p0063), the $2,500/month support fee (p0086), the Supplemental Payments share of third-party amounts actually received (p0074, p0078) and taxes (p0051). There is no minimum-volume commitment, shortfall true-up, minimum fee on termination or late-payment interest/penalty anywhere; on termination our only obligations are to cease use, return materials and certify (p0138), and Article IV preserves for Licensor only "the right to receive payments for all trades performed using the Licensed Technology" (p0049), i.e. accrued fees rather than remaining contract value. Article XXIII expressly bars termination damages against either party, which runs in our favour. Two adjacent items were considered and are not Customer-payable LDs: the audit cost-shifting if a discrepancy over 5% is found (p0064) is a conditional cost-reimbursement, not stipulated damages, and the prevailing-party attorneys' fees provision (p0150) is mutual. The share rebates and bonus shares (p0075-p0076) run from Licensor to us and are therefore compliant by the detection guidance. No redline proposed.
